narrative.rotation_signal: Clear rotation OUT of consumer tech (AAPL, AMZN), money-center banks (JPM, AXP), and chip designers (AMD, INTC) INTO semi-equipment (AMAT, KLAC), healthcare (LLY, UNH), defensives (KO, COST, PM), and energy (CVX).
